# Two windows serving one path is refused at build time. Route mode registers
# a `GET <path>` per window on one mux, and net/http panics on the second at
# startup -- so the program built and then could not start.
#
# Three ways to get there: a second window whose id is `index`, which still
# takes `/` beside the first window's default; two windows with no id, both of
# which default to `/`; and two paths that differ only in a parameter's name,
# which a mux matches as one pattern.

! sngl generate --lang go --platform html -o out-index index.sngl
stderr 'window "home" and window "index" both serve /; give one of them an href'

! sngl generate --lang go --platform html -o out-unnamed unnamed.sngl
stderr 'window 1 and window 2 both serve /'

! sngl generate --lang go --platform html -o out-params params.sngl
stderr 'window "byName" and window "byID" both serve /p/\{id\}'

# Two different shapes conflict too when some path matches both and neither is
# more specific: `/p/q` is either. Only identical shapes were caught.
! sngl generate --lang go --platform html -o out-overlap overlap.sngl
stderr 'window "pa" serves /p/\{a\} and window "bq" serves /\{b\}/q, which match some of the same paths with neither more specific'

# A more specific path beside a general one is what a mux is for.
sngl generate --lang go --platform html -o out-specific specific.sngl

-- index.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window #home(title="Home") {
    ui.text(value="home")
}

ui.window #index(title="Index") {
    ui.text(value="index")
}
-- unnamed.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window(title="A") {
    ui.text(value="a")
}

ui.window(title="B") {
    ui.text(value="b")
}
-- params.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct ByName {
    name string
}

struct ByID {
    id string
}

ui.window #byName(href=`/p/{name}`, params=ByName{}) {
    component content(p) {
        ui.text(value=p.name)
    }
}

ui.window #byID(href=`/p/{id}`, params=ByID{}) {
    component content(p) {
        ui.text(value=p.id)
    }
}
-- overlap.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct A {
    a string
}

struct B {
    b string
}

ui.window #home(title="Home") {
    ui.text(value="home")
}

ui.window #pa(href=`/p/{a}`, params=A{}) {
    component content(p) {
        ui.text(value=p.a)
    }
}

ui.window #bq(href=`/{b}/q`, params=B{}) {
    component content(p) {
        ui.text(value=p.b)
    }
}
-- specific.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct A {
    a string
}

ui.window #home(title="Home") {
    ui.text(value="home")
}

ui.window #pa(href=`/p/{a}`, params=A{}) {
    component content(p) {
        ui.text(value=p.a)
    }
}

ui.window #pq(href="/p/q", title="Q") {
    ui.text(value="q")
}
